stem: The owner of an auto-rickshaw in Chennai bought it new for 320,000 rupees. For accounting purposes, the value of the auto-rickshaw is reduced by 6 percent of its purchase price at the end of each year. Which function gives the value \(V(t)\), in rupees, of the auto-rickshaw \(t\) years after it was bought, for \(0 \le t \le 10\), where \(t\) is a whole number?
solution: Each year the value drops by the same amount: 6 percent of 320,000, or \(0.06(320{,}000) = 19{,}200\) rupees.

explanation.A: Incorrect. This uses 6 instead of 0.06 for 6 percent; the value would already be negative after 1 year.
explanation.B: Incorrect. This reduces the value by 6 percent of the current value each year (exponential decay). The reduction here is 6 percent of the purchase price, the same amount every year.
explanation.D: Incorrect. This subtracts only 0.06 rupee per year instead of 6 percent of 320,000 rupees.

verify:
choices = {o: choices[n] for o, n in {'D': 'A', 'A': 'B', 'C': 'C', 'B': 'D'}.items()}; answer = {'A': 'D', 'B': 'A', 'C': 'C', 'D': 'B'}[answer]  # shuffled: original letters
t = symbols('t')
rhs = lambda s: value(s.split('=')[1])
V = 320000 - Rational(6, 100)*320000*t
assert [k for k in choices if simplify(rhs(choices[k]) - V) == 0] == [answer]
assert V.subs(t, 1) == 300800
